answer_card.title: Create an event stream for TF Actions
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Go to **Automation Decisions > Event Streams** and click **Create event stream**.
2. Set **Name**, **Organization**, **Event stream type** = **Basic Event Stream** (username/password) and a pre-created **Credential**.
3. Optionally list **Headers** to forward (empty forwards all).
4. Keep **Forward events to rulebook activation** on (turn off to test without triggering automation).
5. Create it, then add the stream to a rulebook activation, enable **Rulebook activation enabled?**, and activate.
